outbuildings.name: Outbuildings
outbuildings.else: The shed is padlocked. The gardener keeps it shut until evening.

garden.name: Garden
garden.description: A walled garden. The house is east and a shed stands to the north.

around.say: You walk around the garden and end up where you started.

shed.name: Shed
shed.description: A tool shed. A bell hangs from a beam.
